answer: Time-locked staking freezes the attacker's capital. Honest side: lock 150 units for 20 epochs, unlock 5% per honest epoch, full return in 20 epochs. Fake side: cheating freezes the stake, resets the timer, and a whisper of fraud triggers review; confirmed forgery slashes 60%. The locked funds cannot roll into the next batch of clones. To forge 1,000 identities the attacker must lock 150,000 units at once, and at a 30% detection rate the expected slash is 27,000 units plus 10 more frozen epochs. The beacon is simple: time is the one cost a forger cannot print.
